scope: Older dictionary snapshot confirms form/lemma membership only; Kaikki tagged evidence supplies tense/person. These are different snapshots of Wiktionary, not independent dictionaries.

editorialDecisions.escribir: Use escrito, not the archaic escripto.
editorialDecisions.pagar: Use general modern pagado in perfects, not regionally surviving pago.
editorialDecisions.elegir: Use elegido, preferred for compound tenses.
editorialDecisions.describir: Retain descrito/descripto; label the latter Río de la Plata.
editorialDecisions.haber: Separate impersonal hay from auxiliary ha; only ha habido for the impersonal perfect. Do not teach archaic commands.
editorialDecisions.restricted: Preserve third-person tables for ocurrir/suceder/consistir in their taught sense; explain command non-use.
